column1: # Adapters coming and going WHILE traffic flows.
# Three limits, easy to conflate:
#   registered  --lora-modules entries vLLM holds
#   indexed     names the HTTPRoute matches on   <- the 7 ceiling
#   concurrent  adapters resident at once        <- --max-loras, DEFAULT 1
# kserve emits --max-loras only when MaxAdapters is set (#280), so the
# fixture runs on vLLM's default of 1: measured LoRAConfig.max_loras=1 and
# no --max-loras in the pod argv.
# gateway http://172.18.255.2  pod svc-a-kserve-bbb4c4d6c-27b2p  reqs/burst 12  cycles 3
# --- phase 1: concurrency vs one resident slot ---
scenario
same adapter throughout
alternating two adapters
alternating base and adapter
# --- phase 2: churn the adapter that traffic is using ---
# Traffic runs continuously against adapter-a1 on the service-scoped path
# while the adapter is unloaded and reloaded underneath it.
# in-window = requests that STARTED while adapter-a1 was unloaded.
# Without that column the phase reports a clean run while measuring nothing.
cycle
# --- phase 3: runtime-only adapter, no route entry, no restart ---
step
before load
after load
after unload
